data.body:
[P2] Pair input completion export with successful delivery acknowledgment

A FLAT parallel using `first_successful()` can leave wait B pending while the root waits on A. When B completes, both views now export B during a checkpoint-free PENDING invocation that skips the completed parallel. The local runner clears `UpdatedOperationIds` at invocation start but never advances `handler_seen_seq` after that valid response. Once A completes, a subsequent step checkpoint returns B again, and the fresh plugin ledger exports a duplicate completion. Acknowledge the captured invocation sequence after response validation in the local runner, preserving newer updates, and add this three-invocation regression.
